Technology Trader Apple Rakes In Profits As It Awaits the Next Big Leap Consumers are sated and the technology has plateaued—for now. But so far there’s no crisis, with companies still minting money. By Tiernan Ray May 5, 2018
Is it a good thing or a bad thing if Warren Buffett becomes your top shareholder?
Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway (ticker: BRKA) is almost there with respect to Apple (AAPL), as he indicated to CNBC on Friday morning. Berkshire bought another 75 million shares recently, to hold 240.3 million shares in total, a position of some $44 billion, or about 5% of Apple’s common stock. Apple is expected to be Berkshire’s top position, and the biggest stake it’s ever held in another company, and it puts Berkshire third in line behind Vanguard...
